cfo_brief: Revenue grew $2.50B QoQ (+8.32%), from $30.04B in Q2 2024 to $32.54B in Q3 2024, per consecutive 10-Q filings dated 2024-08-22 and 2024-11-22 with no FX, M&A, or reclassification items present, indicating the gain is organic and demand-driven. The increase coincides exactly with a same-day (11/22) CNBC report describing "unprecedented demand" for Nvidia Blackwell chips, pointing to AI infrastructure spending as the primary revenue catalyst rather than pricing or portfolio shifts. Because the news and filing dates are identical, the critical open question for Q4 guidance is whether this $2.5B lift reflects Blackwell revenue already booked in Q3 or merely the market's anticipatory reaction to backlog/orders that will convert in Q4.

external_signal.headline: Nvidia Blackwell chips see unprecedented demand.
